singleton_rule: Every distinct event action in teacher, first allocation and completed update training draws is isolated; all remaining supported actions stay in risk-by-log-LR strata. No new outcomes or validation labels enter design.
scope: Measure conditional J on all 33 locked training states. Frozen teacher Q_A is the estimand, not the measurement proposal. No new source or population claim.
budget: 128 direct Q_A draws and 128 risk-by-log-LR stratified moment probes per state; 8448 native continuations. Equal deterministic stratum counts; all action schedules fixed before outcomes. No extension or weight clipping.
decision: Use simultaneous exact binomial bounds for all state/stratum cells. Certify candidate Q_S only if the upper bound on its same-target IID M2 difference against alpha is strictly negative; otherwise retain alpha. No production change or PPO launch.
